query: SELECT c.id, c.name, u.id as userId, u.name as userName, uca.userId as accessUserId FROM companies c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.ownerUserId = u.id LEFT JOIN userCompanyAccess uca ON c.id = uca.companyId WHERE c.name LIKE '%SIGE%' OR c.name LIKE '%Consultores%';
